sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:162

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:162:1
items.html: Actually night, more than at the time of the evening prayer, therefore this coupling is inferior: For until the evening prayer, there still remains some continuation of the Mochin of the day, meaning that there still remains the discernment of the surrounding lights of Katnut of Ima from the Mochin of the day, meaning that AHP have not yet departed from ZON, and they have ten vessels; and therefore there is then no need for the first intercourse, as above. Unlike after the blessing “He who casts,” when their AHP have already descended, and they have returned to actual Katnut, for there remains in them only the internality of the Mochin of Katnut of Ima, namely the NR [Nefesh-Ruach] of nursing; thus they are no longer fit for coupling at all, and they need the advancing of the first intercourse, which suffices only to make her a vessel, which is the discernment of the surrounding lights of Ima of Katnut — this being now done in the Shema upon the bed. Thus this coupling of the Shema upon the bed is more inferior than the Shema of the evening, for this coupling is only to make her a vessel alone, which is only the discernment of a preparation for the ascent of MAN.
